1) Audit window: Our latest SOC 2 Type II report covers 2025-08-01 through 2026-07-31 (so it does include July 2026).
2) Bridge letter: not needed for this period, but we can provide a one-page management assertion if you prefer a succinct summary.

How we’ll send the materials: pick one of the following (we’ll proceed on your preference):
- Option A (recommended): S3 presigned URL (AES-256 at rest), link expires in 7 days. Files: SOC2_TypeII_report_redacted.pdf, management_assertion.pdf.
- Option B: Secure SharePoint folder (company-controlled access, 90-day audit log retention).
- Option C: Encrypted zip via our secure file transfer (password over separate channel).

Attached is a short transfer-options matrix for your InfoSec team. For quick acknowledgement, here’s the one-line reply you can use after download: 
"Thanks — we have received Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and management assertion; we’ll reach out if we need additional artifacts"

If you prefer the presigned S3 link, we’ll email it from secure@redwood.ai and include: redacted PDF, management assertion, and a small evidence index (list of sample artifacts available on request). Please confirm which option you prefer and whether your team needs any specific redactions beyond customer names and tenant IDs.

Best,
